{{Top}}
[[File:UnderworldHotel-TWJ.png|thumb|right|180px|A [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]] hotel]]
'''Hotels''' were buildings in which visitors to a given [[City/Legends|city]] or [[Planet/Legends|planet]] could stay. Such buildings were continually utilized by [[Lobar Aybock]]. There were also mobile hotels, such as the [[Alderaanian flying hotel|flying hotels]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
